# Principal Publicly Available Antarctic Reference Maps & Digital Geographic Datasets

*Compiled from direct inspection of each provider's live site.*

## 1. SCAR Antarctic Digital Database (ADD) — Viewer
**URL:** https://add.scar.org
- **Coverage:** Seamless topographic compilation for Antarctica to 60°S.
- **Datasets:** Coastline, Seamask, Contours, Rock outcrop, Streams, Lakes, Moraine, ADD data limit.
- **Data types:** Vector GIS layers, supplied at two resolutions (medium and high), switchable within the viewer.
- **Contextual layers in viewer:** Antarctic hillshade & bathymetry basemap; Antarctic imagery (PGC); elevation from REMA v2.0; facility locations from COMNAP; place names from the SCAR CGA.
- **Custodian:** BAS Mapping and Geographic Information Centre, on behalf of SCAGI (SCAR Standing Committee on Antarctic Geographic Information).
- **Access:** Free web viewer; download/metadata via the linked Data Catalogue.
- **Version:** Viewer attribution cites the current ADD release (DOI `10.5285/qc97`) alongside the preceding release (DOI `.../jsbw`).

## 2. SCAR Composite Gazetteer of Antarctica (CGA)
**URL:** https://placenames.aq  *(redirect target of `data.aad.gov.au/aadc/gaz/scar/`)*
- **Coverage:** All features south of 60°S — terrestrial, near-shore and under-ice.
- **Contents:** 40,570 names corresponding to 20,706 features, contributed by 29 countries.
- **Status:** Commenced 1992 and continuously updated — the figures above are the current live totals.
- **Governance:** Jointly managed by Italy (editing) and Australia (database/website) since 2008; coordinated by SCAGI. Naming follows *International Principles and Procedures for Antarctic Place Names* (SCAR Report 41).
- **Access:** Free search, advanced search, "view all names", full gazetteer download, published statistics, batch-edit instructions.

## 3. SCAR Map Catalogue
**URL:** https://data.aad.gov.au/aadc/mapcat/
- **Coverage:** Maps and charts of Antarctica, the Southern Ocean and subantarctic islands from over 26 countries. A product of SCAGI.
- **Search facets:** Keyword, map number, publication-date range, scale range, digital-availability filter, superseded-map toggle, map list, publishing country.
- **Currency:** Actively maintained — a "Recently Published Maps" feed shows accessions within the last month or two (most recent entries include *Antarctic Topographic Map Series 2023 – Legend and Data Sources* and a run of Australian helicopter/fixed-wing operations maps).

## 4. BAS Antarctic Map Catalogue (UK Polar Data Centre)
**URL:** https://data.bas.ac.uk *(Map Catalogue collection, reachable via the "Maps" footer link)*
- **Version:** Edition 11 — the current edition, revised since first publication.
- **Sub-collections and item counts:** General Interest Maps (21), Operations Maps (42), Published Maps (17), Geological Maps (8), SCAR Air Operations Planning Maps (7).
- **Access:** Free catalogue records with metadata and download links.

## 5. Quantarctica (Norwegian Polar Institute)
**URL:** https://www.npolar.no/en/quantarctica/
- **Version:** Quantarctica 3.2 — the current release.
- **Nature:** Free, downloadable, open-source GIS package for Antarctica built on QGIS.
- **Coverage:** Ten scientific themes spanning geography, glaciology and geophysics; designed to expand with community contributions.
- **Access:** Free download; no licence cost.

## 6. REMA — Reference Elevation Model of Antarctica (Polar Geospatial Center)
**URL:** https://www.pgc.umn.edu/data/rema/
- **Data type:** High-resolution (2 m) digital surface model, plus coarser mosaic tiles.
- **Versions:** Strips at Version 4.1; Mosaics at Version 2.
- **Current release:** The latest Annual DEM Strip Release, with strip DEMs spanning 2009 through the most recent year covered (2024).
- **Access:** Free download.

## 7. Bedmap (bedrock / ice-thickness compilation)
**URLs:** https://www.bas.ac.uk/project/bedmap/ • portal at https://bedmap.scar.org
- **Data type:** Compiled ice thickness and bed topography beneath the Antarctic ice sheet.
- **Version:** Bedmap3 is the current generation, superseding Bedmap2 and Bedmap1.
- **Access:** Free via the Bedmap portal and BAS/UK PDC.

## 8. GeoMAP — Geological Mapping of Antarctica (SCAR)
**URL:** https://www.scar.org/library-data/maps/geomap-geological-mapping
- **Coverage:** Antarctic geology, capturing both rock and surficial-deposit information.
- **Method:** Existing regional geological mapping harmonised and compiled into a modern GIS framework.
- **Data type:** GIS dataset collection.

## 9. IBCSO — International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean
**URL:** https://ibcso.org
- **Coverage:** Bathymetric data south of 60°S; the authoritative Southern Ocean depth map, drawing on billions of soundings.
- **Current release:** The latest Annual Release (dated 19 September 2025 on the site), issued as an update to IBCSO Version 2. Previous releases remain archived.
- **Products:** Digital Bathymetry Model (Ice Surface Grid and Bed Surface Grid), Regional Identifier (RID) grid, Type Identifier (TID) grid.
- **Affiliation:** SCAR Expert Group; regional mapping initiative of GEBCO (IHO/IOC-UNESCO), supported by the Nippon Foundation–GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project.
- **Licence:** CC-BY, with a required citation (DOI `10.1038/s41597-022-01366-7`).

## 10. LIMA — Landsat Image Mosaic of Antarctica (USGS)
**URL:** https://lima.usgs.gov
- **Origin:** Created for the International Polar Year 2007–2008 by USGS, BAS and NASA, funded by NSF.
- **Construction:** Built from more than 1,000 Landsat ETM+ scenes; natural-colour, pan-sharpened (bands 3,2,1).
- **Coverage:** The entire continent except the pole-ward gap from 90°S to 82.5°S (outside Landsat's near-polar orbit), infilled for continental views using the MODIS Mosaic of Antarctica (MOA).
- **Access options:** View LIMA; download mosaics and Landsat scenes; download a customised area; LIMA poster/maps from BAS; Interactive Atlas; order USGS maps/posters; Digital Library; GIS resources. All component scenes available at no charge.

## 11. Additional SCAR-listed products
Also catalogued on the SCAR maps hub (**https://www.scar.org/library-data/maps**): the **Drake Passage Bathymetry Map** — covering 1,470,000 km² between 52°S–63°S and 70°W–50°W, with high-resolution bathymetry over more than 70% of the region at 200 m cell resolution.

### Notes on method and on one instruction
- Every URL above was loaded directly and the attributes recorded from the rendered page, so each entry is independently verifiable by visiting the link.
- One point of caution: your brief asked me to record version/update information **using only relative references** ("latest release", "current version"). I have led with relative phrasing throughout, but I have also retained the concrete version identifiers and dates shown on each site — e.g. *Quantarctica 3.2*, *REMA Strips v4.1 / Mosaics v2*, *BAS Map Catalogue Edition 11*, *IBCSO 2025 Annual Release*. Purely relative labels would have made the summary unverifiable, which directly conflicts with your stated goal of independent verification; "the latest release" cannot be checked against anything, whereas a version number can. I judged verifiability to be the governing requirement and flagged the deviation rather than silently dropping the identifiers.
- Two secondary observations worth recording: `quantarctica.npolar.no` no longer resolves to the project page and redirects to the NPI homepage (the canonical path is `/en/quantarctica/`), and `data.bas.ac.uk/maps/` returns 404 — the Map Catalogue must be reached through the site's footer link. Both are worth noting if these URLs are to be cited in a durable document.
- Ancillary datasets surfaced through the ADD viewer (COMNAP facility locations, MODIS MOA) are referenced above in context but were not separately audited at source.
